name: Camera pin
author: DecompRecomp
description: Test tool: holds the duel camera at a chosen angle and distance during chosen scene phases (default every phase). MEMORIES_MOD_CAMERA_PIN_ANGLE / _DISTANCE / _PHASES set them for one run.

settings.label: Angle (-1 off)
settings.description: The camera's heading in a 4096-unit turn; 1024 is the duel's usual view.

settings.label: Distance (0 off)
settings.description: How far the camera is from the mat; 600 is usual, 200 closest.

settings.label: Phase mask
settings.description: Bit mask over the scene phase: 4 hand, 5 field, 9 battle. 65535 = every phase.
